description: This file contains implementation of conversion and helper functions for Android graphics buffer handling, including native handle creation, wrapping/unwrapping of graphics buffers, and conversion between different graphics-related data structures and types within the Android namespace.

classes.name: GraphicBuffer
classes.description: Represents a graphics buffer with methods for flattening/unflattening.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: Rectangle structure used in buffer and region handling.

classes.name: Region
classes.description: Represents a collection of rectangles defining a region.

classes.name: HdrMetadata
classes.description: Metadata related to High Dynamic Range imaging.

classes.name: HGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Namespace containing graphics buffer producer related structures.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryDelta
classes.description: Tracks frame timing and fence information.

methods.name: native_handle_create_from_fd
methods.description: Creates a native handle containing a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: native_handle_read_fd
methods.description: Reads a file descriptor from a native handle.

methods.name: toStatusT
methods.description: Converts Return<void> to status_t for legacy binder calls.

methods.name: inHidlHandle
methods.description: Wraps a native handle in a hidl_handle.

methods.name: toHardwareDataspace
methods.description: Converts int32_t to Dataspace enum.

methods.name: toRawDataspace
methods.description: Converts Dataspace enum to int32_t.

methods.name: inHidlBytes
methods.description: Wraps a buffer pointer into a hidl_vec<uint8_t> without copying.

methods.name: toHidlBytes
methods.description: Creates a copy of a buffer as hidl_vec<uint8_t>.

methods.description: Wraps GraphicBuffer attributes into AnwBuffer.
